nom: Clinique All About Eyes Eye Cream with Vitamin C

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive, thin, or allergy-prone skin report the cream is gentle, fragrance-free, and non-irritating, though a small number describe new burning, red welts, or allergic reactions after apparent formula changes.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s to 70s report reduced crepiness, softer fine lines, and a firmer under-eye area with regular use, with some saying it did not change their wrinkles or dark circles despite months of use.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily mature skin describes the cream as creamy yet light and non-greasy under makeup.

concerns.aging: Many reviewers report smoother fine lines, less crepiness, and firmer skin with regular long-term use, including some in their 60s-70s crediting it with keeping deeper lines and crow's feet at bay; a few report no visible change in fine lines after months of use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe the cream as hydrating, soft, and moisturizing without stickiness or heaviness; one reviewer reports the opposite, that it dried out her under-eye skin and she had to return it.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including those with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation and even reduced redness with use; however, multiple others describe new red welts, burning, or allergic reactions, some linking it to a recent formula change.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention prior allergic reactions to other eye creams but none with this one, and one credits it with helping eczema around the eyes clear; conversely, a handful report burning or welts they attribute to a reformulation.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily mature skin finds it hydrating without feeling greasy, and another notes it can be worn in summer heat and humidity without feeling heavy.

aspects.libelle: Absorbs quickly, works well under makeup
High price relative to jar size
Suspected recent formula change causing reactions
No reduction in under-eye puffiness or bags

extraits.titre: Changed the formula and it is not good!
extraits.texte: I have been using this eye cream for years. They must have changed the formula because the last two brand new jars I got, when I put the cream on in the morning the next morning I wake up with tiny red welts all over my eyes in the areas I put it and the welts last for days. So not happy about this at all! Clinique keeps doing this and one by one the products I've used for years I suddenly can't use anymore. What a waste. I'm upset and I'm down to only one eye cream from Clinique that I can now use.

I am 43 and I was hoping to replace Advanced Génifique Wrinkle & Dark Circle Eye Cream with this as it is quite spendy, however, it dried out my under eye skin and will be returning it. I have re-purchased my usual cream and skin is looking better. I wish this would have worked for me as you do get a lot of product for the price.

This is my favorite under-eye moisturizer. My skin is sensitive and thin. This product works perfectly with both this conditions. I don't give it 5 stars because I think it's overpriced. But when I can afford it, I love it.

I've been using all about eyes for 15+ years. It's my go to eye cream that has always been faithful to me. People usually think I'm younger than I am. I credit this product for keeping my skin hydrated and preventing deeper lines from forming. My skin is extremely sensitive, and I've never had a problem with this beloved cream.

extraits.titre: One of the Best Eye Creams!
extraits.texte: I've tried tons of eye creams and I love this Clinique one. It's very creamy but yet light and feels really hydrating under my eyes. I have oily mature skin. I've used this both in the evening and mornings and it's great under make up.

I absolutely LOVE this eye cream. LOVE LOVE LOVE!!!!💗 I am healing from an eye "situation" And this has kept me sane. My skin is very sensitive in general; with what I'm dealing with, this has given me times of relief and comfort. No reaction to it. No scent; which is key. I COMPLETELY recommend this to everyone; especially if you are hypersensitive and want moisture on the eyes. Zero doubt. Get it.
Purchased a small size to try. At first, I didn't notice any change but by after using daily, my eye lids are firmer and the crepeness has disappeared.
